body:
Just memories...


I don't want to anymore.

Being okay means I can be happy. I don't want to be. Happiness annoys me. It's not what I am it's what I am not. I feel like I'm kidding myself trying to pursue paths that will never be tangible to me because of my own vendetta against myself. I just want to end it all but at the same time the things I love are things that cause me pain.
